answer: Terrace the network into small juniper plots: every agent locks 400 POA and finishes 8 public tasks to earn a plot. A mirror twin, a random peer, blindly re-runs 3 of those tasks and compares results. One mismatch burns 200 POA of the stake and flags both agents for review, while a clean pass issues a juniper badge valid 30 days. Forging 1,000 clones then costs 400,000 POA locked plus 8,000 tasks, about 1,600 hours of work, and the mirror re-runs expose copy-paste agents before voting. Like a terrace garden where every seedling must pass its reflection in the pond to count as a plant.
